points: Refusal failures rose by up to 68.7% in relative terms across three benchmarks
Based on more than 100,000 responses from open and closed models
read: Abstract only; full text was unavailable. NVIDIA affiliation is reported by press, not confirmed on the page read
take: Every leading model tested was less safe with tools than without. Safety tests run on a chat model do not cover the same model as an agent.
title: NeurIPS paper: AI models refuse harmful requests less when using tools
